k1_import.pagination: At most500 rows and1MB per call; default dry-run true creates no batch.
k1_import.notes: Exact source/version/content replay returns same batch; conflicting content fails. New version appends immutable rows. Disable preserves evidence and exposes preceding enabled versions. Demo clinical/regulatory rules are rejected.

k1_medicines.pagination: Ascending UUID keyset, default30/max100. next_after nullable. Latest enabled effective version per source-name/source-code, then filters. Include demo only explicitly.
k1_medicines.notes: SOURCE_RECORDED is provenance recording, not independent clinical/regulatory verification. Missing reference rules remain unknown. No stock, price or capability inference.

k2_diagnostics.pagination: Ascending UUID keyset, default30/max100. next_after nullable. Latest enabled effective version per source-name/source-code, then filters. Include demo only explicitly.
k2_diagnostics.notes: SOURCE_RECORDED is provenance recording, not independent clinical/regulatory verification. Missing reference rules remain unknown. No stock, price or capability inference.

register_demo_patient.role: Authenticated user onboarding only their own account.
register_demo_patient.consent: No existing clinical history access granted by registration.
register_demo_patient.facility: Provider onboarding can create an owned pending facility; this is not operational approval.

register_demo_provider.facility: Provider onboarding can create an owned pending facility; this is not operational approval.

t1_replay.pagination: Keyset descending by recorded_at, event_key. Supply both next_cursor values together. Default50, max100. next_cursor may yield an empty last page.
t1_replay.notes: Late evidence orders by recorded_at while occurred_at preserves actual event time. BASELINE means captured existing state; absent historical transitions are not reconstructed.

t2_twin.shape: CareTwin (see FRONTEND-FINAL-CONTRACTS.md for nested domain shapes)
t2_twin.pagination: One episode. Nodes/gaps/pathways/external claims capped100; diagnostics/prescriptions/referrals/followups/payer capped50; emergencies/critical capped30. Omitted records beyond caps require domain worklists.
t2_twin.notes: No diagnosis or disease simulation. External claims remain verification pending and never close care by themselves.

t3_pulse.pagination: One fixed completed calendar month within24months; no patient filters. Cohort minimum20; numerator and complement each minimum10. Suppressed counts both null.
t3_pulse.freshness: Current recorded source state for a historical appointment cohort, not a reconstruction of end-of-month state. last_refreshed is projection time.
t3_pulse.notes: No names, patient IDs, phone/address/ABHA. Threshold suppression is not a differential-privacy guarantee. Unmapped practices excluded; no inferred geography. Current capability/stock aggregate is separate from the historical cohort; provider stock maps only to single-site pharmacies.

t4_join_intent.notes: No credential is returned by this RPC. Call the authenticated teleconsult Edge endpoint to obtain a short-lived provider token. Service-role issuance context and master keys never reach the browser.

t4_open.notes: Stable appointment/session identity. Opening alone does not create a provider room. Join policy: appointment minus15minutes until plus2hours; individual issuance intent expires within2minutes. No recording.
